title: Estimators, maximum likelihood and MAP
description: Bias and variance of an estimator, standard error, the N-1 variance, negative log-likelihood, Gaussian noise as least squares, and a Gaussian prior as L2 regularisation.

title: Confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and the bootstrap
description: Confidence intervals, p-values and their pitfalls, multiple comparisons, paired model comparison and bootstrap intervals.

title: Sampling: inverse transform, rejection, MCMC
description: Inverse transform sampling, rejection sampling and its high-dimensional failure, the Metropolis algorithm and Gibbs sampling.

title: Monte Carlo integration and importance sampling
description: Expectations as sample averages, the 1/sqrt(N) error, importance weights p/q and when they fail.

title: Floating-point formats
description: IEEE-754 float64, float32, float16 and bfloat16: mantissa, exponent, machine epsilon, range, overflow and underflow.

title: Numerical stability
description: Catastrophic cancellation, stable softmax and log-sum-exp, Welford variance, condition number, summation order and finite-difference step size.

title: Tensors, broadcasting and einsum
description: Rank and shape, deep-learning tensor layouts, strides, broadcasting rules and einsum notation.

title: Norms, distances and the curse of dimensionality
description: L1, L2, Linf, Frobenius and spectral norms, cosine and Mahalanobis distance, and concentration of distances in high dimension.
